basic_info.description: Welcome to 2737 22nd St. in the vibrant Inner Mission. Separate metered two-unit building with solar panels.  Top unit 1 bedroom 1 bath fully remodeled with top of line appliances and refinished hardwood flooring.  Electrical in the entire building upgraded with subpanels in each unit.  Two car garage with 11-foot ceilings with ample parking for two vehicles and a possible ADU.  Centrally located within easy access to transportation and employment centers. Just two blocks from Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital. Walking distance to BART, restaurants, and coffee shops. This property presents an excellent opportunity for both investors and owner-occupants.
